name: The Bamboo Room
description: Mahjong social club in Vienna. Its own listings call open play "NMJL American" for all levels and teach American mahjong, with Mahjong 101 and 102 lessons, instructor-led guided play, skill-building series and happy-hour open play. Memberships and a gift card are sold on its site.
address: 101 Church Street NW, Unit D, Vienna, VA 22180
schedule: Open play, lessons and guided play most days (dates listed on the club site)
